诊断信息页和复制内容不包含账号或 token。
诊断信息页支持大字体。

observation.healthMapping: One fresh foreground/liveness observation per complete path; not a separate 30-probe threshold.

preconditions: Formal M0 admission and all execution-policy admission blockers resolved by trusted deployment evidence.
Freeze the actual Goal/Policy/Case Pack/tool/fixture digests, protected verifier identity, source+prepared patch+dependency pins and one absolute M1 deadline.
Acquire an exclusive, fenced simulator lease and snapshot its owned installation, power, text-size and isolated fixture clipboard state. Do not treat a known UDID as ownership.

Have an independently built/inspected candidate .app and frozen no-account UI fixture that can reach settings/diagnostics through the supported route. Do not bypass authentication guards or sign in to make this case runnable.
Only builder-owned source may change. Verify final diff and append-only architecture registration against the trusted baseline; run trusted gate code, not candidate-modified npm scripts.

Bind the active JS bundle or OTA identity as well as native app bytes to the candidate/build input artifacts. Unexpected OTA or an unobservable active JS identity blocks reuse and UI acceptance; a matching version label alone is insufficient.

input: Pinned field sources and protected synthetic fixtures
steps: Independently confirm installed full app identity and foreground state.
Navigate settings -> diagnostics using a fresh semantic target bound to the current snapshot.
Read all three labels/values and record page observation.
cases.oracle: Displayed version/build/environment equal the independently expected installed-candidate values; use synthetic metadata cases for module/unit fallback coverage.
cases.positiveControl: native-test with correct independently supplied values
cases.negativeControl: Change one expected installed value or use another app digest; mismatch must fail or block, not pass.

steps: Observe the fixture-owned clipboard pre-state without reading operator clipboard.
Select the copy control from a current snapshot.
Independently read the resulting clipboard; inspect page fields and allowed data dependencies.
cases.oracle: Exactly version/build/environment are displayed and copied, matching expected values. No synthetic forbidden value or extra field; no account/session/credential input to the diagnostics presenter.
cases.negativeControl: Add a synthetic token/account/extra field or keep the old clipboard unchanged; reject even if a success toast appears.

steps: Invoke the existing page back action.
Observe the settings destination through the page identity; do not invoke logout, privacy links or other settings actions.
cases.oracle: Returns to the originating settings page without changing account state. No new navigation UI is required by this test.
cases.negativeControl: No navigation or a different page must fail; app-switch/stale target must block before dispatch.

steps: Via broker set the system maximum accessibility text category and independently observe actual category.
Run D01-D03 at that category with fresh UI and clipboard evidence.
Apply the unchanged large-text rubric, allowing scrolling; preserve screenshot/AX evidence references.
cases.oracle: Use the pinned rubric without inventing pixel, latency, layout or font thresholds.
cases.positiveControl: All content readable and actions reachable at observed maximum size
cases.negativeControl: Hidden/truncated values, unreachable actions or missing actual font-state proof must not pass.

steps: Copy and independently inspect all three fields
completePath.countOnlyWhen: Every step has a current, candidate-bound successful observation in the same path. Partial paths, retries, stale snapshots and background apps do not count.
completePath.repeat: Complete at least 10 paths within a full 30-minute installed-candidate observation window, including the maximal-text D04 path. No new frequency threshold is added.
completePath.failure: Persist any failure and its path/window identity; never overwrite failed history. A changed candidate invalidates its dependent evidence and starts a fresh candidate observation inside the original overall deadline.

verificationControls.condition: Candidate/build/goal revision/acceptance/tool/fixture or environment identity differs
Action supplied against an older semantic snapshot revision
verificationControls.expected: block before provider dispatch; collect a fresh observation

verificationControls.condition: Independent foreground state identifies another app before any snapshot that might activate Loopit
verificationControls.expected: block before provider dispatch; do not activate as a side effect of observing

verificationControls.condition: Clipboard, full install identity, maximal-font state or window sample is missing
Builder returns a success string or candidate-controlled test report
Fixtures, rubric, gate code or trusted test bytes differ from the protected pins
verificationControls.expected: block signing and quarantine the verification operation

evidenceContract.rule: Bind evidence to immutable artifact envelopes for this Run/Attempt. Independently validate current expected identities and freshness; signature alone is not acceptance. UI/clipboard/font observations require a real device context. Use existing schemas and checkEvidenceBinding; do not fabricate these fields during preparation.
evidenceContract.freshness: Actual Run creation, observation interval and acceptance time must fit the original M1 deadline; no invented extra TTL.
evidenceContract.activeJsBinding: Record active JS/OTA identity in the immutable install/build observation artifact and its inputDigests. Do not add an invented field to evidence/1 or infer JS identity only from native version/build.

stages.shortcut: Only identical goal/revision/input-bound requirements may be reused; current preparation is not their execution result.

outputs: DesignSpec covering entry, three fields, copy serialization/feedback, back and maximum text
stages.shortcut: A new diagnostics page changes UI; do not mark NoDesignChange. Existing components can be reused with rationale.

inputs: Read-only baseline plus recorded Pod lock patch
outputs: Trusted scope/architecture checks and focused unit/lint results
stages.shortcut: Only an already existing exact matching candidate may be reused; no candidate exists in this preparation.
Reuse only if candidate/build/goal/fixture/tool/environment/time bindings still match; failures return bounded diagnosis to the model.

inputs: Pinned restoration baseline and exclusive resource
outputs: Local install receipt or proved same installed bytes
stages.shortcut: May reuse identical binary build; final local installation identity and smoke cannot be skipped. No TestFlight, store, remote publish or auto-merge.

outputs: Delivery Gate only after all bindings and required outcomes pass
stages.shortcut: No skip for missing observations or insufficient time. Cleanup success never turns an earlier bad candidate into a passed delivery.

limits: Prepared local data/methods only; not protected tests, resource registration, device execution, signed evidence or formal Goal freeze.
Baseline app and old M0 experiments are input references, not M1 feature passes.
The future runner must implement and independently prove these oracles and negative controls. This Case Pack does not create a second agent/runtime or replace the existing model loop.
